qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Dominant Italian banking franchise whose vast branch network feeds captive wealth management (Eurizon, Fideuram) and insurance divisions, generating high fee income and sticky low-cost retail deposits.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 6 (Balance Sheet & Cash Conversion, REJECT). Outstanding domestic banking and wealth management franchise led by top-tier management (Carlo Messina), but operates as a commercial fractional-reserve bank with >15x leverage on tangible equity and structural exposure to credit cycles and Italian sovereign debt (BTP) spreads.
qualitative.evidence: Intesa Sanpaolo generates superior returns on tangible equity (ROTE 15-18%) powered by captive wealth management (Eurizon, Fideuram). However, with total assets exceeding €900B against ~€55B in tangible equity, it relies fundamentally on fractional-reserve leverage, deposit duration transformation, and ECB liquidity backstops. Commercial deposit banks fail Gate 6 by design under the Munger peace-of-mind balance sheet standard.

evaluation_metadata.verdict: Rejected – G6 Cash & Fortress Balance Sheet
